title: indigo_mount_nexstaraux: coordinates ALERTs bypass indigo_update_coordinates(); MOUNT_PARK writes the park position into the equatorial targets
description: Two defects: (1) MOUNT_EQUATORIAL_COORDINATES ALERTs are published with indigo_update_property() instead of indigo_update_coordinates(), so they are not kept; (2) MOUNT_PARK writes the park position into the targets of MOUNT_EQUATORIAL_COORDINATES, although targets may hold only the client's request. Found while working on ticket 42b85be0-1f19-4607-b3c3-746e60317d17 (closed, commit a09e0f878), which introduced the kept coordinates ALERT in indigo_update_coordinates(): an ALERT published after a BUSY stays until the next BUSY. Reproduce in the driver's simulator suite before changing code.
